# Shared setup for the five decks + cheat sheet (labs carry their own inline copy so each lab stays a standalone script).
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(broom); library(gtsummary); library(nnet); library(ordinal); library(brant) })
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 16))
mat_path <- c("data/maternal_survey.csv", "../data/maternal_survey.csv", "../../data/maternal_survey.csv")
mat_path <- mat_path[file.exists(mat_path)][1]
mat <- read_csv(mat_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(education = factor(education, levels = c("None", "Primary", "Secondary", "Higher")), residence = factor(residence, levels = c("Urban", "Rural")), tribal = factor(tribal, levels = c("No", "Yes")),
         anaemia = factor(anaemia, levels = c("None", "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe"), ordered = TRUE), delivery = factor(delivery, levels = c("Home", "PHC", "Public hospital", "Private hospital")))
col_blue <- "#3498db"; col_red <- "#e74c3c"; col_navy <- "#2c3e50"; col_green <- "#27ae60"

m1 <- MASS::polr(anaemia ~ wealth, data = mat, Hess = TRUE)
round(exp(cbind(OR = coef(m1), confint(m1))), 2)
m1$zeta |> round(2)

m2 <- MASS::polr(anaemia ~ wealth + education + bmi + anc_visits + parity + age + tribal + residence, data = mat, Hess = TRUE)
round(exp(cbind(OR = coef(m2), confint(m2))), 2)     # tbl_regression(m2, exponentiate = TRUE) formats this for a paper

nd <- data.frame(wealth = c(1, 5), education = factor("Primary", levels = levels(mat$education)), bmi = 20.5, anc_visits = 3, parity = 2, age = 27,
                 tribal = factor("No", levels = c("No", "Yes")), residence = factor("Rural", levels = c("Urban", "Rural")))
rownames(nd) <- c("poorest", "richest")
round(predict(m2, newdata = nd, type = "probs"), 2)
c(ordinal = unname(exp(coef(m1))), binary_any_vs_none = unname(exp(coef(glm(I(anaemia != "None") ~ wealth, family = binomial, data = mat)))["wealth"])) |> round(2)
